lines.prompt: Find all articulation points in the combinational graph between n2 and n14.

golden.reference: There are no articulation points between n2 and n14 because no combinational path exists between them (n2 feeds only DFF D-pins, n14 is driven directly by DFF g1032's Q output).
golden.notes: All four teams conclude none exist. The essential claim: no combinational path between n2 and n14, therefore zero articulation points. No numeric requirement: all three full-score teams answered in words ('no articulation points/gates') without stating a literal 0; only Team4 wrote 'Found 0'. Team7's explanation (n2 -> D-pin of g564; n14 driven by Q of g1032) is a good model rationale but not required.

team_answers.Team2: No combinational path between n2 and n14; no articulation gates.
team_answers.Team3: No articulation points; no path exists between the two signals.
team_answers.Team7: None; no comb path. n2 feeds DFF D-pin g564; n14 driven by DFF Q of g1032; graph between them empty.

lines.prompt: Report the number of each gate type in the cone of n14.

golden.reference: The cone of n14 contains 0 combinational gates of every type (AND/OR/NOT/NAND/NOR/XOR/XNOR/BUF all 0) and 1 DFF (g1032); total 1 gate.
golden.notes: Domain prior applies: the official golden INCLUDES the boundary DFF in the cone, so DFF count must be 1 (not 0). Full-score Team2/Team3 report DFF: 1 without naming the instance, so naming g1032 is OPTIONAL (same convention as test76 line 12). Full-score Team7 reports 0 comb gates plus DFF instance g1032 counted separately - also accepted since the DFF is present. Team4 reported DFF: 0 with no DFF mention -> this is one of its two lost points. Checker: all comb types 0 AND a DFF count of 1 (inline or the DFF instance listed separately).

team_answers.Team3: All comb types 0, DFF 1; total 1 gate.
team_answers.Team4: Cone contains 0 gates; all types 0 including DFF: 0. (WRONG - missing DFF)
team_answers.Team7: 0 combinational gates; boundary DFF g1032 counted separately.

lines.prompt: Compute the fanin logic cone of output n14 and list all gates that contribute to this output.

golden.reference: The fanin cone of output n14 contains 1 gate: the DFF g1032 (n14 is driven directly by its Q output; no combinational gates contribute).
golden.notes: Domain prior: boundary DFFs belong in the cone. Full-score Team2/Team3 say 1 gate, g1032. Full-score Team7 says 0 combinational gates but explicitly names DFF g1032 as the boundary element - naming g1032 is the load-bearing part, so the count is presentation-dependent and NOT a hard numeric requirement (Team7 scored full without stating 1). Team4 said the cone contains 0 gates with no instance named -> its second lost point. Checker: must name g1032; count 1 (or 0 comb + 1 DFF listed separately) both acceptable.

team_answers.Team2: Transitive fanin cone contains 1 gate: g1032.
team_answers.Team4: Fan-in cone contains 0 gates. (WRONG - g1032 missing)
team_answers.Team7: 0 combinational gates; only boundary element is DFF g1032, counted separately.
